messages:
sam: FYI when I run the node quickstart the logs show full trace IDs and a raw cookie header. is that expected?

mira: we should never print cookies. can you paste the exact log line?

sam: sure: [INFO] 2028-09-03T14:05:45.123Z request received method=POST path=/v1/generate trace_id=af23b9f4-1c2d-4e5f-9a3b-0c7d8e9f1a2b headers={"cookie":"session=eyJhbGci...","authorization":"Bearer sk-REDACTME"}

jordan: oof — looks like our OTEL hook is running after the logger sanitizers, so headers are intact when serialized.

cleo: which SDK? node or go? we had a parity gap where node autoinit order differed.

sam: node v0.12.3 quickstart, no custom init.

mira: yep that matches the bug we fixed in go. node autoinit sequence currently: logger -> otel -> http hooks. should be logger -> redact -> otel.

jordan: short-term workaround: set REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT=always and REDWOOD_OMIT_HEADERS=[cookie,authorization]. forces logger to drop those keys before OTEL sees them.

sam: tried REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT=always, cookie gone from console but seeing trace_id and auth in a separate telemetry span output (different sink).

cleo: are you using the built-in otlp exporter? there's an exporter-level attribute scrubber that runs after instrumentation but before export — we missed porting it to node.

infra-bot: deploy 2080012400 to dev: telemetry-redact-hotfix (successful) :rocket:

mira: pushed a tiny hotfix to force exporter scrubber earlier: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/827 (will backport). can you test `npm i github:.../sdk-node#hotfix/early-scrub`?

sam: installing now... quick test logs look much better, cookie gone. trace_id still full UUID in span attrs though — is that okay?

jordan: trace_id in spans is expected for tracing correlation, but console logs should show only a short req id. set REDWOOD_LOG_TRACE_TRUNCATE=8 to show first 8 chars only.

sam: set it, looks clean. thanks!

cleo: action items: 1) node SDK: backport exporter scrubber & fix autoinit order. 2) docs: quickstart mention REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT and trace truncation. 3) add e2e sample app test asserting no header values in any log sink.

mira: creating tickets and adding to next sprint. cc @jordan for release notes.

sam: great, this fixed my onboarding friction. :tada:

infra-bot: ticket created #DEVEX-4123 "node: ensure header redaction precedes otel instrumentation on autoinit"

jordan: i'll add a console UI note about mapping trace_id -> request_id for debugging without exposing full IDs.

sam: thanks everyone, leaving thread open until backport lands.
